name: Stare of the Predator
body:
Your gaze is both hypnotic and deadly to those caught by it.

Prerequisites: Character level 5th, vulture-man.

Benefit: You gain the hypnotic stare and painful stare mesmerist class features and qualify for stare feats. Your effective mesmerist level for these abilities is equal to your character level -4.

Special: If you gain hypnotic stare or painful stare from another source, add your total levels in classes without those features when determining your effective mesmerist level.
